qa_pairs.question: Is it recommended to consult with technical staff before submitting an application for the Resource Allocation Competition (RAC)?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, it is strongly recommended that all applicants consult with the technical staff responsible for the clusters they intend to use. This ensures the technical aspects of the proposals align well with the requested clusters, benefiting the Principal Investigator (PI). PIs who have not previously used these clusters should discuss their proposal with technical staff before submission, allowing time for discussion or revisions if needed. If you do not know the appropriate technical staff to contact, you can email allocations@tech.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What is the application process for the Resource Allocation Competition (RAC)?
qa_pairs.answer: Any researcher interested in applying to the Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) must first be registered with the CCDB. All applications must then be submitted electronically through the CCDB’s Resource Allocation Competition page.

qa_pairs.question: Is a large research team or significant funding required to apply for a Resource Allocation Competition (RAC) allocation?
qa_pairs.answer: No, academic Principal Investigators (PIs) can apply for an allocation, irrespective of the size of their research team or the amount of funding received.
